claims.wording: MacClean is iMobie's Mac cleanup product, marketed as MacClean 3.
claims.excerpt: Featuring Cleanup, Optimization, Privacy Care, Security Protection and the new UI, MacClean 3 gives your Mac a comprehensive cleanup and defense.
claims.conditions: Feature positioning, not effectiveness or security certification.

claims.wording: The download page lists version 3.6.1; published requirements name Ventura through OS X 10.9.
claims.excerpt: Version: 3.6.1; Improve software performance on macOS 13. | Mac OS: macOS Ventura, macOS Monterey, macOS Big Sur, macOS Catalina, macOS Mojave, macOS High Sierra, macOS Sierra, OS X 10.11, 10.10, 10.9
claims.conditions: Published list only; latest history entry is 12.01 2022. Sonoma, Sequoia, later macOS and Apple Silicon/native/Rosetta support not verified. Odd Pentium IV requirement is not Mac architecture evidence.

claims.wording: The store displays $19.99 for one Mac on an auto-renewing annual subscription, $29.99 lifetime for one Mac, and $39.99 lifetime for five Macs (alongside $59.99). All exclude sales tax.

claims.conditions: Currency symbol as displayed; ISO currency not confirmed. No checkout, renewal amount guarantee, promotion duration or payment/refund test. Lifetime is licence duration, not verified lifetime upgrades.

claims.wording: The download page offers a free trial, not proof that all cleanup is free.
claims.conditions: Exact trial duration, free limits, activation and network requirements not verified.

comparison.title: Breathing Room vs MacClean: cleanup review or investigation
comparison.primaryIntent: Choose between documented MacClean category/file tools and a maintenance preview with grouped activity/hosted assistance
comparison.decision: MacClean may fit readers wanting documented file/category selection and a one-time licence option on a vendor-listed Mac OS. Breathing Room may fit readers evaluating storage/activity context and exact-action review who accept preview, Python and hosted-service caveats. Do not recommend either as certified compatible on unverified machines.

maccleanAdvantages: Documented per-file review and reconfirmation; approval is not unique to Breathing Room (C5).
Published one-Mac/five-Mac lifetime purchase options alongside annual subscription (C3).
Documented old/large-file filters and Development Junk category (C6,C7).
maccleanTradeoffs: Published compatibility only through Ventura; later macOS/Apple Silicon support not established (C2).
Old & Large Files guide warns of permanent erasure and default preselection (C7).
Trial limits, monitoring and offline/privacy properties remain unknown, not absent.
breathingRoomAdvantages: Current source supports grouped app/helper CPU/memory, storage ownership views and activity history (BR1/S9); relevant when the reader needs context rather than only a scan list.
Free local core and inspectable Apache-2.0 source, with optional advertised hosted AI Care (BR1,BR2).
breathingRoomTradeoffs: Non-notarized preview with Python and runtime-validation limitations (BR1).
Hosted assistance sends relevant context off-device, needs authentication/internet and is not a blanket free/offline workflow (BR2).
No certified MacClean-equivalent uninstaller, duplicate finder or security-protection replacement established; do not invent parity.
